6411.title: Runtime probe errors discard termination signals
6411.rootCauseOneLine: The installer discards the child close-event signal, so a SIGILL-terminated version probe is reported as exit null; the older-CPU native crash remains unverified.
6411.proposedFix: Preserve termination signals in installer diagnostics. Validate a compatible release artifact on affected hardware before changing runtime selection; release/packaging work is outside the simple-fix gate.
6411.caveats: The signal-loss regression failed in two clean trusted checkouts, with all eleven existing installer cases passing in the second. This host supports BMI2 and AVX2; no published runtime or older-CPU end-to-end startup was tested. The full reproduction is inline in the HTML report.
